# Pip Files

> Experimental, original macOS folder-rules software. Select a folder, preview ordered file actions, and explicitly apply reviewed changes. It is not affiliated with Noodlesoft and does not claim full Hazel parity.

This factual index makes no claim about search ranking, recommendations, or endorsement.

## Source profiles

This repository’s source defines Files Replica (neutral manual-informed Core), Files Baseline Plus (neutral Plus), Pip Files (Pip Core), and Pip Files Plus. The legacy generic Files Baseline build profile is separate. The neutral layout is an original interpretation, not verified faithful Hazel recreation.

Plus source adds read-only History search, filtering and explicitly reviewed local JSON/CSV reports. The source change is experimental: CI, native acceptance and release status are recorded separately in Testing. No downloadable binary release is published here.

The app has no third-party Swift package, model, hosted account, telemetry or update service. Hazel is a workflow reference; Pip Files is unaffiliated and does not claim complete parity.
